notes: Customer: mid-market e-commerce platform focused on specialty home goods; catalog ~5M SKUs (mix of variants).
Primary ask: semantic product search + downstream reranker to boost conversion on long-tail queries; reduce poor ranking of variant-heavy products.
Performance targets: p50 end-to-end query <80ms, p95 <250ms (including retrieval + rerank). Will accept hybrid: sub-100ms for short queries, higher for complex multi-attribute reranks.
Cost target: average cost-per-customer-query target <$0.03 across peak and steady state; sensitivity to per-token costs for reranker stage (want bundling/quantized embeddings).
Indexing: daily full re-index cadence; incremental updates every hour for inventory/pricing. Current embeddings pipeline built on open models; exploring quantized vectors to reduce memory footprint.
Scale concerns: 5M vectors, expected growth to 8-10M in 12 months. Seasonal traffic expected 6-10x (Black Friday/Cyber); need burst capacity and predictable throttling/fallbacks.
Routing/fallback: prefer dedicated for capacity predictability; want automatic fallback to smaller/cheaper model variant during spikes with graceful degradation.
Security: SOC2 posture required, SSO/SAML, KMS for key management, audit logs with 1 year retention, EU data residency for EU storefronts.
Quote from Head of Search: 'We need reranker improvements where we actually see conversion lift — not just nDCG bumps. Cost needs to stay reasonable during Nov-Dec spikes.'

POC plan agreed: Redwood to run 2-week POC on 1M SKU slice (US + EU subsets). POC success metrics: query latency p95 under 300ms at 4x baseline load, cost per query estimate <= $0.03, >6% CTR improvement on long-tail queries in A/B test.
Drive assets: pricing deck shared; security FAQ under review. SE note: will try embedding quantization + hybrid ANN (HNSW + product-level reranker) during POC.
Mail cadence: weekly wrap-up emails; current thread includes infra diagrams + dataset sample (see Drive).
Internal: AE/Maya to push procurement checklist once security questionnaire complete; SE/Diego owns POC orchestration and test harness.
Short-hand items: 'need demo w/ BlackFri sim', 'ask: cost calc per q + burst cap', 'blocker: legal needs DPA before prod'.
